title: He can't have been... He must have been... 他那时不可能…… 他那时肯定是……
translation: 他那时不可能…… 他那时肯定是……
description: A picture lesson on past deduction: 'can't have been' (negative certainty about the past) and 'must have been' (positive certainty about the past). Eight pictures show deductions about a man's past condition, a hat, a woman's nationality, a man's job, ages, a date, family birth order and what a man was doing. The lesson introduces written exercises on completing sentences with 'had to' or 'must have been', and writing new sentences with 'can't have been' and 'must have been'. The workbook drills choosing the correct form of must / can't and reacting to situations; the grammar workbook rewrites sentences using 'can't have been/done' and 'must have been/done'.
answer_note: The listening captions are model answers (suggested). Textbook written exercises A (complete with had to / must have been) and B (write new sentences with can't have been / must have been) are model answers (suggested). Workbook A (write in the correct form of the verbs) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-129-135.jpg p.216); Workbook B (situations) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-129-135.jpg p.216). Grammar I (rewrite with can't have been/done) and II (rewrite with must have been/done) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.566).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

1. He can't have been ill. He must have been tired.
2. It can't have been my new hat. It must have been my old one.
3. She can't have been Danish. She must have been Swedish.
4. He can't have been a dentist. He must have been a doctor.
5. She can't have been forty. She must have been fifty.
6. It can't have been the 20th. It must have been the 21st.
7. He can't have been the youngest. He must have been the oldest.
8. He can't have been reading. He must have been sleeping.
lesson.translation:
1. 他那时不可能生病了。他那时肯定是累了。
2. 那不可能是我的新帽子。那肯定是我旧的那顶。
3. 她那时不可能是丹麦人。她那时肯定是瑞典人。
4. 他那时不可能是牙医。他那时肯定是医生。
5. 她那时不可能四十岁。她那时肯定五十岁了。
6. 那不可能是二十号。那肯定是二十一号。
7. 他那时不可能是最小的。他那时肯定是最老的。
8. 他那时不可能在阅读。他那时肯定在睡觉。

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。
lesson.context: One question per picture (8 pictures); the answer is the spoken past deduction from the picture captions.

questions.prompt: What was wrong with him? (Picture 1)
questions.answer: He can't have been ill. He must have been tired.

questions.prompt: Whose hat was it? (Picture 2)
questions.answer: It can't have been my new hat. It must have been my old one.

questions.prompt: Where was she from? (Picture 3)
questions.answer: She can't have been Danish. She must have been Swedish.

questions.prompt: What was his job? (Picture 4)
questions.answer: He can't have been a dentist. He must have been a doctor.

questions.prompt: How old was she? (Picture 5)
questions.answer: She can't have been forty. She must have been fifty.

questions.prompt: What was the date? (Picture 6)
questions.answer: It can't have been the 20th. It must have been the 21st.

questions.prompt: Where did he come in the family? (Picture 7)
questions.answer: He can't have been the youngest. He must have been the oldest.

questions.prompt: What was he doing? (Picture 8)
questions.answer: He can't have been reading. He must have been sleeping.

lesson.title: Written A: Complete these sentences
lesson.instruction: 完成以下句子，用 had to 或 must have been 填空。
lesson.translation: 完成以下句子，用 had to 或 must have been 填空。
lesson.context: 6 fill-in items; 1 example printed on the page (He is very tired because he had to get up early this morning. → He didn't get up early this morning. He must have been tired.).

questions.prompt: He didn't come to work yesterday. He ___ ill.
questions.answer: must have been

questions.prompt: He didn't come to the office this morning. He ___ stay at home.
questions.answer: must have been

questions.prompt: I don't think she was Austrian. She ___ German.
questions.answer: must have been

questions.prompt: I lost my pen so I ___ buy a new one.
questions.answer: had to

questions.prompt: He forgot his case so he ___ return home.
questions.answer: had to

questions.prompt: She didn't hear the phone. She ___ sleeping.
questions.answer: must have been

lesson.title: Written B: Write new sentences
lesson.instruction: 模仿例句改写以下句子。
lesson.translation: 模仿例句改写以下句子。
lesson.context: 20 rewrite items; 1 example printed on the page (I think she was Danish. (Swedish) → I don't think she was. She can't have been Danish. She must have been Swedish.).

questions.prompt: I think she was fifty-five. (under fifty)

questions.prompt: I think she was old. (young)

questions.prompt: I think he was ill. (tired)
questions.answer: I don't think he was. He can't have been ill. He must have been tired.

practice.title: Practice A: Must be and can't be
practice.instruction: Write in the correct form of the verbs with must or can't (must be, can't be, can't have been, must have been, can't have been doing, must have been doing). 选用 must 或 can't 以及正确的动词形式填空。
practice.translation: 选用 must 或 can't 以及正确的动词形式填空。
practice.context: 10 fill-in items choosing the correct form of must / can't; item 1 (must have been) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I don't think he was Russian. He ___ (must / be) German.
questions.answer: must have been

questions.prompt: Liz wasn't at work yesterday. She ___ (can't / be) very well.
questions.answer: can't have been

questions.prompt: He didn't answer the telephone, so I think he ___ (must / sleep).
questions.answer: must have been sleeping

questions.prompt: Your uncle ___ (can't / be) fifty years old! He looks about 30!
questions.answer: can't be

questions.prompt: She had an accident. She ___ (can't / drive) very carefully.
questions.answer: can't have been driving

questions.prompt: That man isn't a mechanic. Look at him. He ___ (must / be) a pilot.
questions.answer: must be

questions.prompt: Have you finished that book already? You ___ (must / read) very quickly.
questions.answer: must have been reading

questions.prompt: Her birthday was a week ago, so it ___ (can't / be) on the 25th.
questions.answer: can't have been

questions.prompt: Andy didn't play very well in the football game. He ___ (must / be) ill.
questions.answer: must have been

questions.prompt: What were they doing? They ___ (can't / do) their homework because there was too much noise.
questions.answer: can't have been doing

practice.title: Practice B: Situations
practice.instruction: Read these situations. What do you say in each? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.translation: 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.context: 3 situation items giving advice or promises using 'had better' / 'I'll certainly'.

questions.prompt: A friend of yours has a bad toothache. How do you advise him or her to go to the dentist's?
questions.answer: You'd better go to the dentist's.

questions.prompt: Your teacher says you haven't written enough for your homework. How do you promise to write more next time beginning with 'I'll certainly ...'?
questions.answer: I'll certainly write more next time.

questions.prompt: A friend of yours went to the cinema without permission. How do you warn or advise him / her not to tell his / her parents?
questions.answer: You'd better not tell your parents.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Rewrite the sentences using 'can't have been/done'
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 can't have been/done 改写下列句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 can't have been/done 改写下列句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.566 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 12 rewrite items; item 1 (I don't believe he did it. → He can't have done it.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I don't believe he did it.
questions.answer: He can't have done it.

questions.prompt: I don't believe you tried very hard.
questions.answer: You can't have tried very hard.

questions.prompt: I don't believe you were at the office on Sunday.
questions.answer: You can't have been at the office on Sunday.

questions.prompt: I don't believe he was ill yesterday.
questions.answer: He can't have been ill yesterday.

questions.prompt: I don't believe you saw me.
questions.answer: You can't have seen me.

questions.prompt: I don't believe there were many people there.
questions.answer: There can't have been many people there.

questions.prompt: I don't believe it was so cold in your city last winter.
questions.answer: It can't have been so cold in your city last winter.

questions.prompt: I don't believe you telephoned me.
questions.answer: You can't have telephoned me.

questions.prompt: I don't believe she made the dress.
questions.answer: She can't have made the dress.

questions.prompt: I don't believe you failed the Maths test.
questions.answer: You can't have failed the Maths test.

questions.prompt: I don't believe she was so lucky.
questions.answer: She can't have been so lucky.

questions.prompt: I don't believe he sold his car.
questions.answer: He can't have sold his car.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Rewrite the sentences using 'must have been/done'

grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 must have been/done 改写下列句子。
